decisions.reason: GA4 remains the standard analytics setup for online shops, so a dedicated tracking plugin still fits the firm's core implementation and support business.
A Universal Analytics plugin no longer has meaningful market demand after Google's shutdown, so keeping it would tie up resources with little strategic value.
A retail system interface plugin matches the firm's integration capabilities and client needs, even if it is likely a narrower niche than its main service lines.
SEO support for shop relaunches is closely aligned with the firm's relaunch, marketing, and conversion offering and appears to be a well-positioned service.
SEO workshops use the firm's existing expertise and can support client acquisition and upselling, although they are somewhat less central than hands-on shop services.
